subject.title: [Feature]: Pattern-based channel allowlist for Discord (glob/wildcard support)

question: Should Discord guild channel allowlists support glob-pattern keys such as `ws-*`, and what precedence should they have relative to exact entries, disabled entries, thread-parent fallback, category inheritance, and the literal `*` entry?
rationale: This would add a public Discord config syntax and change which guild messages can reach agents, so automation should not choose the authorization semantics.

options.title: Approve narrow glob contract
options.body: Add Discord-owned glob matching with explicit precedence, schema/types/docs, audit/status handling, and focused ingress tests while keeping category inheritance and broader access-list redesign separate.

options.title: Fold into broader access redesign
options.body: Keep this open but defer implementation until the Discord category or access-control trackers define one dynamic channel authorization model.

options.title: Reject glob syntax
options.body: Document exact entries plus literal `*` and leave dynamic workflows to category inheritance or another maintainer-approved access-control design.

recommendation.title: Approve narrow glob contract
recommendation.body: Add Discord-owned glob matching with explicit precedence, schema/types/docs, audit/status handling, and focused ingress tests while keeping category inheritance and broader access-list redesign separate.
